data.title: Emergencies — Starter · Lesson 4
data.subject: emergencies
data.lyrics:
Let's go… ¡Vamos!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
There is a fire.… Hay un incendio.
Call for help.… Llama para pedir ayuda.
We’re here for you today.

[Verse]
Met new neighbors, friendly smiles,
they said "Nice to meet you" for miles.
Good morning… Buenos días
How’s it going?… ¿Cómo va?
In case of trouble, they explained,
"Remember these words," they proclaimed.
Call a tow truck.… Llama a la grúa.
Find a shelter.… Busca un refugio.
There is a leak.… Hay una fuga.
Cut the power.… Corta la corriente.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
Tornado warning.… Alerta de tornado.
I need a first aid kit.… Necesito un botiquín.
We’re here for you today.

[Verse]
Heard a noise, couldn’t see,
asked them "What could it be?"
There is a lot of noise.… Hay mucho ruido.
They nodded, understood my worry.
In emergencies, stay calm they said,
know these words, keep them in your head.
Help is near.… La ayuda está cerca.
Call the police.… Llama a la policía.
Stay inside.… Quédate adentro.

vocab.en: I need a first aid kit.
There is a lot of noise.
